_comment: Edit products here; the cards, the home-page features and the product popup are all built from this list. img is a base path: the site loads img-480.webp and img-800.webp.

products.title: Saraswati Chowki
products.label: Ritualistic Chowki
products.description: Traditionally painted for initiation rites and seeking wisdom. This Chowki features the geometric Saraswati symbol in the center, encircled by traditional white lines (Biswar) over an auspicious red Geru base. Ideal for study rooms, libraries, and spiritual settings.

products.title: Goddess Lakshmi Chowki
products.label: Ritualistic Chowki
products.description: Invites wealth, prosperity, and joy into your home. Features the symbolic footprints of Goddess Lakshmi pointing inward (symbolizing arrival) surrounded by detailed geometric border designs and auspicious lotuses.

products.title: Auspicious Swastika Chowki
products.label: Ritualistic Chowki
products.description: A symbol of positive energies and good fortune. This wooden Chowki is coated with authentic Geru clay and hand-painted with standard rice paste patterns. Used widely in all traditional festivals and home worships.

products.title: Vasudhara Heritage Painting
products.label: Divine Wall Art
products.description: Vasudhara represents streaming wealth and blessings. Hand-drawn by local Kumaoni women artisans, this framed masterpiece features vertical parallel lines representing streaming abundance, bounded by intricate Aipan borders.

products.title: Ashtadal Kamal Wall Frame
products.label: Divine Wall Art
products.description: A beautiful rendering of the sacred eight-petaled lotus (Ashtadal Kamal). A symbol of purity and cosmic order, this painting brings serene energies and serves as a premium aesthetic accent for home entrances.

products.title: Hand-painted Pooja Thali
products.label: Sacred Home Decor
products.description: A stainless-steel base thali treated and hand-decorated with high-durability waterproof Aipan-inspired patterns. Perfect for festivals like Diwali, Karwa Chauth, or daily worship rituals.

products.title: Aipan Decorated Diya Set
products.label: Sacred Home Decor
products.description: A set of 6 traditional clay diyas hand-plastered with Geru and decorated with detailed white rice-paste creepers. Includes natural wax fillings. A lovely eco-friendly festive decor piece.
